before.positive:
A real photograph, a still frame from a live-action commercial shot on a large-format 65mm digital cinema camera. EXACTLY 1 vehicle in frame: Red sedan in the centre.

Red sedan: centre of frame, about 9 metres from camera, driving. Every grey vehicle in the layout is a real car on a real road, and every other grey shape is a real object: the road, a post.

Camera at about 62 cm above the ground, level, 33mm lens, natural perspective, background slightly soft, filmed from a camera car driving alongside at about 58 km/h, road and background streaking with motion blur, wheels blurred.

Red sedan is the one in image 3: Car reference sheet on a plain light gray studio background: the same glossy cherry red modern four-door sports sedan with black wheels show.

Worn asphalt with tyre marks and cracks, concrete barriers with grime, dry roadside grass, a post made of real, used materials.

Late-afternoon sun from camera right, about 30 degrees high. The light falls directly on the subjects and the ground around them. Exposed for the main subject; shadows stay open, with readable texture in the ground and foreground, never pure black.

Tactile realism: readable colour, soft highlight roll-off, truthful skin colour, restrained fine grain over a sharp image. Texture comes from real surfaces and light, never a filter. Any signs or screens have no readable letters.

If any surface looks clean, plastic, grey, untextured or rendered, the image is wrong.
before.motion: A car chase through traffic on the highway. Low angle. Filmed from a camera car driving alongside at the same speed, about 58 km/h, the road and background streaming past.
